newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietnam sells 81.6 bln dong T-notes, rate 11.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam sells 81.6 bln dong T-notes, rate 11.3 pct.

text.p: Vietnam sold 81.6 billion dong ($6.98 million) worth of one-year Treasury notes with an annual coupon of 11.3 percent to domestic institutions at an auction on Wednesday, an official at the State Bank of Vietnam said.
At the last sale of government paper, on July 23, the central bank sold 16.6 billion dong worth of one-year notes at a rate of 11.0 percent.
The issue date of the notes sold on Wednesday is August 1 and maturity will be on August 1, 1998.
The bank said allotments of stock, in dong, were:
Bank for Foreign Trade of Vietnam (Vietcombank) 45.0 billion
Industrial and Commercial Bank of Vietnam 30.0 billion
Vietnam General Insurance Corporation (Bao Viet) 5.0 billion
